school.lastAdmin: The school must keep at least one admin

schools.hint: Send a request — the school admin will approve it, and you’ll see the school’s classes.
schools.pending: Request to “{name}” sent. Wait for approval.
schools.pendingOther: You already have a pending request
schools.alreadyMember: You’re already a member of this school
schools.noneHint: Check the name or ask the school admin to add the school to the system.
admin.title: Platform schools
admin.noTeacher: No teacher is registered with this email
devices.title: School computers
devices.hint: Add a computer, then enter its code in the Sinf app on that machine.
devices.name: Name
devices.none.hint: Add a computer here, then enter its code in the app on that computer.
devices.recodeConfirm: Unlink “{name}”? The app on this computer will stop working until a new code is entered.
session.lock.soft: In the browser the lock is soft: the screen is covered, but the keyboard and mouse still work.
session.joinHint: Students open the website and choose their class
session.keys: Use the ← → keys to switch screens
join.title: Choose your class
join.waiting: The teacher hasn’t started the lesson yet. Please wait…
student.startHint: Click to open the lesson in full screen
student.waitTeacher: Look at the board: the teacher is showing something
student.ended: The lesson is over. Well done!
present.title: Projector
player.layout: The keyboard is set to English. Switch the language: Alt + Shift
student.fullscreenHint: Press Esc to exit full screen
teacher.demo.hint: Students open the website, click “I’m a student” and choose their class.
teacher.demo.hintDesktop: Students open {url} on their devices, click “I’m a student” and choose their class.
teacher.students.title: Students
teacher.code.confirm: Give {name} a new code? The old card will stop working.
cards.title: Code cards
cards.perPage: 8 cards per A4 sheet. Print with Ctrl+P, no margins.
join.code.title: Lesson code
join.code.hint: The teacher shows the code on the board
join.locked: Too many tries. Wait {sec} seconds and try again.
join.locked#one: Too many tries. Wait {sec} second and try again.
student.kicked: You signed in on another device. The lesson is closed here.
student.name: You are {name}
rest.title: Look away from the screens!
rest.hint: Rest your eyes. The lesson will continue soon.
admin.none.hint: Create a school above, then assign its admin by a teacher’s email.
sync.title: Lesson results
sync.never: Not connected to the platform yet
quiz.title: Quiz
quiz.question: Question {n} of {total}
quiz.wrong: Not quite. The right answer is {letter}
results.title: Lesson results
results.live: The lesson is still going: only students who joined are shown. The rest will be marked absent when it ends.
results.gradeHint: Grade 2–5 based on the lesson’s stars: from {five}% — “5”, from {four}% — “4”, from {three}% — “3”, below that — “2”. Parts of the lesson that didn’t take place are not counted.
results.gradeOff: Grades 2–5 are turned off for this class. You can turn them on on the class page.
results.gallery.empty: No one took part in the practice in this lesson.
journal.title: Gradebook: {name}
journal.empty.title: No lessons taught yet
journal.empty: A lesson will appear here once you end it.
journal.legend.stars: Each cell shows the stars for the lesson; “abs.” means absent. Click a date to open the lesson summary.
journal.legend.grades: Each cell shows a grade from 2 to 5; italics mean a grade suggested from stars that hasn’t been confirmed in the lesson summary yet. “abs.” means absent. Click a date to open the lesson summary.
class.settings.title: Grades
class.settings.hint: {five}% of the lesson’s stars or more — “5”, {four}% or more — “4”, {three}% or more — “3”, less — “2”. Applies to past lessons too.
class.settings.locked: This setting is changed by the class teacher on the platform website.
demo.title: Demo showcase
demo.subtitle: Class 1A: virtual students and demo reset
demo.virtual.title: Virtual students
demo.virtual.hint: They are played by the server. They join the lesson within 20 seconds, go through the screens and exercises each at their own pace, sometimes leave the tab and raise a hand, and answer in the quiz. They don’t appear in the class list or at sign-in; on tiles and in the summary they have a “virt.” badge.
demo.virtual.noSession: Start a lesson in class 1A first — virtual students are added to a running lesson.
demo.virtual.session: Lesson “{title}” in progress · virtual students: {count} of {max}
demo.virtual.added: Added. The students will join the lesson within 20 seconds.
demo.virtual.full: The lesson already has {max} virtual students — that’s the limit.
demo.reset.title: Reset demo
demo.reset.hint: Deletes class 1A’s lessons, their summaries and the virtual students, and restores the 20 students with their codes. A running lesson will end. The reset doesn’t touch other teachers, classes or schools.
demo.reset.confirm: Reset the demo? Class 1A’s lessons and their summaries will be deleted.
demo.reset.done: Demo reset: class 1A is back to how it was at the start.
join.waiting.hint: The lesson will open by itself as soon as the teacher starts it.
session.lock.real: On the class computers ({count}) “Attention!” is real: the keyboard and mouse don’t work.
seats.title: Seating
seats.hint: Who sits at which computer. At the next lesson the computer will show the student’s name right away. Drag a name to another computer to swap students, or pick a student from the list.
seats.empty: Class computers will appear here once Sinf opens on them in student mode.
session.moved: {name} signed in on another computer ({to}). The lesson on the previous one ({from}) was closed.
sync.shots: Lessons sent; screenshots waiting for a connection: {count}
results.grades.offered: Suggested from the lesson’s stars, not yet confirmed
files.title: My work
files.teacherHint: The student’s files: saved in lessons and uploaded from home.
files.empty.hint: Save your work here: documents, spreadsheets, drawings.
files.conflict: While you were working, this file was changed somewhere else. Your version was saved next to it: “{name}”.
files.loginAgain: Sign in again to open your work.
files.bad.extension: files of this type can’t be stored
files.bad.size: the file is larger than {max} MB — the limit set by the school
files.bad.quota: the folder is full: delete what you don’t need
my.title: My work
my.classCode.hint: Enter the class code from your card (6 digits).
my.wrongClass: There’s no class with this code. Check the digits on the card.
my.pictures: Your class can open its work only at school.
practice.title: Practice task
practice.subtitle: Build the criteria from ready-made checks and test a correct file: it must pass all automatic criteria.
practice.sample.neat: The document is neat and easy to read
practice.sample.own: The text is the student’s own
practice.label: Criterion as the student and teacher see it
practice.reference.hint: Choose a correctly done file. It is checked in the browser, as in the lesson, and once more on the server.
practice.allPass: The reference file passes all automatic criteria.
practice.notAll: The reference file scored {score} of {max}: see which criteria failed, then fix the file or the task.
practice.serverDiffers: server got a different result — let the developers know
practice.serverFailed: The server couldn’t check the file.
practice.file.unreadable: The file won’t open: make sure it’s a file from the right app.
practice.file.old_or_protected: The file is in an old format (.doc, .xls) or password-protected. Save it again in the new format.
practice.file.wrong_type: The file type doesn’t match the task.
practice.check.docx.headings: Has headings of the right level
practice.check.html.title: Page has a title (title)
share.title: Screen sharing
share.appOnly: Only the Sinf app on the teacher computer can share the teacher’s own screen. To show a student’s screen, use “Show to all” in that student’s screen window.
share.yours: Your screen is being shown to the class
session.apps.hint: Only on class computers, and only the apps installed on them.
lessonPractice.title: Practice
lessonPractice.noTemplate: The task file isn’t in “My work”
lessonPractice.saveHint: Save the file (Ctrl + S) — it will be checked automatically
lessonPractice.uploadHint: Download the task, do it and hand in the file — it will be checked automatically
results.works.hint: ✓ / ✗ is your mark, and it overrides the automatic check. Click again to remove the mark. Handed in is the version at the time of the screenshots at the end of practice.
own.title: My lessons
own.none: No lessons of your own yet: create your first one from the template.
own.noneSchool: Teachers at your school haven’t shared any lessons yet.
own.deleteConfirm: Delete the lesson “{title}”? Summaries of past lessons will remain.
own.onPlatform: Lessons are created and edited on the website; this computer receives them ready-made.
editor.title: Lesson builder
editor.status.failed: Not saved — will retry on the next change
editor.conflict: The lesson was changed in another tab or on another computer. Refresh the page so that no one’s edits are lost.
editor.place.projector: At the projector (the teacher changes slides)
editor.place.computer: At their own computer (each at their own pace)
editor.practiceHint: The practice task (app, template, criteria) is added separately, along with the quiz.
editor.quizHint: The live quiz runs in this stage.
editor.noSlides: No slides — the class will see the stage name.
editor.slideText: Text (an empty line starts a new paragraph)
editor.slideBullets: List: each item on a new line
editor.imageFailed: Couldn’t upload the picture: try another file.
editor.pickSlide: Choose a slide on the left or add a new one.
editor.total90: more than 90 minutes won’t be saved — shorten the stages
editor.pdf.hint: PDF: every page becomes a picture slide, exactly as in PowerPoint (up to 60 pages, 40 MB). PowerPoint (.pptx): the title, text and first picture of every slide become ordinary slides you can edit.
editor.pdf.too_large: The PDF is larger than 40 MB — save the presentation with smaller pictures.
editor.pdf.too_many_pages: The PDF has more than 60 pages — split it into parts.
editor.pdf.unreadable: This PDF didn’t open: it may be damaged or password-protected.
editor.pptx.too_large: The file is over 40 MB — save the presentation with smaller pictures.
editor.pptx.unreadable: This file did not open: it must be a PowerPoint presentation (.pptx), not the old .ppt format.
editor.question: Test question
editor.answers: Correct answers: each on a new line
editor.answersHint: Letter case and extra spaces don’t matter.
editor.problem.text: Write the question — until then it’s a slide and students don’t answer it.
editor.problem.options: Needs at least two answer options.
editor.problem.correct: Mark the correct option (exactly one for “One correct option”).
editor.problem.answers: Enter at least one correct answer.
test.question: Question {n} of {of}
test.several: There may be more than one correct answer.
test.wrong: Not quite. Your answer is saved.
editor.practice.title: Practice task
editor.practice.hint: App, student file and criteria. The student gets the template in “My work”, and every save is checked automatically.
editor.practice.templateSet: Template uploaded: the student will get “{name}”.
editor.practice.noTemplate: No template: the student starts with an empty file.
editor.practice.removeConfirm: Remove the practice task from the lesson?
editor.quiz.title: Live quiz
editor.quiz.hint: Runs in the reflection stage: question and timer on the projector and on students' screens, answers with coloured buttons, points for speed.
editor.quiz.question: Question text
editor.quiz.problem.text: No text — the question won’t be asked.
editor.quiz.problem.correct: The answer marked correct is empty.
student.message.noSites: Websites don’t open in the class app — your teacher will show it.
session.message.badUrl: The link must start with https:// or http://
session.message.soft: In a browser, the child opens the link with a button; in the class app, websites don’t open.
programs.title: Programmes
programs.subtitle: Lessons for the year by term: your own and by other authors. Assign a programme to a class and its next lesson shows on the home page.
programs.name: Programme name
programs.noneSchool: Teachers at the school haven’t shared any programmes yet.
programs.deleteConfirm: Delete the programme “{title}”? Classes that followed it will be left without a programme.
programs.allDone: All lessons in the programme are done.
library.title: Library
library.subtitle: Lessons and programmes that teachers have shared with everyone. Take a copy for yourself and change it as you like.
library.reportReason: What’s wrong with “{title}”? Write briefly — the platform admin will see it.
journal.column.title: What is graded
journal.column.deleteConfirm: Delete the column “{title}” together with its grades?
journal.keys: Click a cell and type: 2–5 for a grade, “n” for absent (in a column without a lesson), Backspace to clear, “c” or double-click for a comment, arrows and Enter to move between cells.
journal.note: Comment on the grade (leave empty to remove):
journal.running: The lesson is still running: grades come after it.
journal.notThere: The student wasn’t at this lesson.
ktp.title: Lesson plans
ktp.subtitle: The calendar lesson plan (KTP) of each class: upload your own Excel or Word file.
ktp.importHint: Choose a class and a file. The wizard finds the table and columns by itself — check them and fix if needed.
ktp.deleteConfirm: Delete the lesson plan “{title}” of class {className}?
ktp.noneHint: Upload a lesson plan from Excel or Word — the same file you hand in to the school admin.
ktp.error.type: Needs an .xlsx or .docx file. Save an old .xls or .doc again in Excel or Word in the new format.
ktp.error.noTable: There is no table in the file. A lesson plan must be a table, with the topic in its own column.
ktp.error.old: The file is password-protected or saved in an old format. Open it and save it as .xlsx or .docx.
ktp.error.big: The file is too large (over 5 MB). Remove the pictures from it and upload it again.
ktp.error.unreadable: Couldn’t read the file. Open it in Excel or Word and save it again.
ktp.onPlatform: Lesson plans are kept on the platform website, not on the school computer.
ktp.name: Title
ktp.fileHint: Excel (.xlsx) or Word (.docx), up to 5 MB
ktp.needTopic: Choose the column with the lesson topic.
ktp.tooMany: The lesson plan has more than {max} topics: only the first {max} will be saved.
ktp.problem.bad_hours: hours are not a number — left empty
ktp.where.noDates: the lesson plan has no dates or weeks — can’t tell if you’re behind
ktp.suggest.found: Lessons similar to lesson plan topics found: {count}
ktp.held: lesson held on {date} — mark as done?
ktp.row.deleteConfirm: Delete the topic “{topic}” from the lesson plan?
ktp.session.title: Lesson plan topic “{title}”
ktp.session.next: the next topic not yet taught — this lesson will be linked to it
school.ktpPercent.hint: How many lesson plan topics a teacher may change, delete or add. Usually 30%.
emaktab.legend: As in eMaktab: only confirmed grades 2–5 and “abs.”, students and dates in the same order. Transferred a column? Click “→ eMaktab” above it.
emaktab.movedAt: Transferred to eMaktab on {date}. Click to remove the mark.
emaktab.onPlatform: eMaktab marks are set on the platform website.
emaktab.reminder: Grades are waiting to be transferred to eMaktab
gradesImport.title: Grades from a file
gradesImport.hint: Class {name}: grades you kept in Excel or Word. Each column you choose becomes a gradebook column.
gradesImport.firstCol: First name (if in a separate column)
gradesImport.noGrades: No grades 2–5 or absent marks found in the table. Check the header row.
gradesImport.twice: This student is already chosen above — this row won’t be imported
schoolSettings.title: School rules
schoolSettings.hint: The same for all classes of the school. Teachers' personal classes follow the default rules.
schoolSettings.maxFileHint: from 1 to {max}, no more than the space per student
schoolSettings.keepHint: Every year on this day, work, screenshots and handed-in files from the past school year are deleted automatically. Grades and the gradebook stay.
schoolSettings.appsHint: Teachers can open only these apps for students on school computers.
schoolSettings.onPlatform: School rules are changed on the platform website.
session.apps.practiceBlocked: This lesson’s practice is in {app}, but the school hasn’t allowed this app: students won’t be able to open it.
schoolSettings.nextTakes: If it ran today, it would delete: screenshots — {screenshots}, files in student folders — {files}, handed-in practice files — {practice}.
school.overview.old: {count} computers on an old version — update to {version}
school.overview.old#one: {count} computer on an old version — update to {version}
invite.title: Invitation to the school “{name}”
invite.hint: Click and you become a teacher at this school: you’ll see its classes, lessons and your colleagues' programmes.
invite.already: You’re already a teacher at this school.
invite.signIn: To join, sign in or sign up — then you’ll come back here.
invite.gone: The link has expired, or the admin revoked it. Ask for a new one.
invite.onPlatform: Invitations work on the platform website.
invite.adminHint: The link works for 7 days, and any number of teachers can join with it — send it to the teachers' chat. No need to accept requests.
invite.once: The link is shown only now. Lost it? Create a new one.
invite.revokeConfirm: Revoke the link? No one else will be able to join with it.
reset.forgotHint: Enter the email address you sign in with. You’ll get an email with a link — it works for 1 hour.
reset.sent: If this address is on the platform, the email has been sent. Check your Spam folder too.
reset.noLetter: No email? Ask your school admin for a password link — they have a button for it.
reset.title: Set a new password
reset.gone: The link doesn’t work: it’s older than an hour, already used, or there’s a newer one.
reset.onPlatform: The password is changed on the platform website.
reset.linkUntil: works until {time}, once only — send it to the teacher
cards.qrHint: QR on the card: in a class with number codes, it opens “My work” from home with the class and name already chosen; in a class with picture codes, it opens the lesson login, where the child sees their pictures right after the lesson code.
report.badPeriod: The period ends before it starts
report.ktpHint: Lesson plan (KTP): done / planned by the end of the period / total topics. Red means behind the plan.
report.lowHint: Red means missed more than a quarter of the period’s lessons.
license.reports: School reports are available with a license. Contact us to renew it.
license.title: License
license.ask: Licenses are issued by the platform — write to us.
license.revokeConfirm: Revoke the license? If there is no other one, the school won’t be able to run lessons in its classes.
license.needed: The school has no active license: new school classes and lessons on classroom computers are unavailable. Contact your school admin.
license.limit: The school has used all {limit} classes of its license. To add a class, the school admin needs to extend the license.
license.personal: A personal class works on the website: lessons on classroom computers are for school classes.
license.free: Free — one personal class. To run more classes, join a school.
